summary: Sony's PlayStation ATV racing series, beginning with Rainbow Studios on PS2 and continuing through Climax-developed sequels and PSP variants.

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 or original PS2 hardware.

primary.why: ATV Offroad Fury is a PlayStation 2-only Rainbow Studios release with 12 ATVs, 20 tracks, multiple event types, stunt scoring, and multiplayer. With no other sourced release route, the original PS2 version is definitive.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original PlayStation 2 hardware or PCSX2.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release with the full game content.

entries.title: ATV Offroad Fury 2

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 or original PS2 hardware.

primary.why: ATV Offroad Fury 2 is a PlayStation 2-only release and the first entry in the series with online multiplayer support. It adds more ATVs, vehicles, mini-games, championships, and trick scoring over the first game.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original PlayStation 2 hardware or PCSX2; original online service availability is historical.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release with online support, expanded vehicles, mini-games, and championships.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or rerelease; original online services are historical.

entries.title: ATV Offroad Fury 3
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation 2 release plus PSP Blazin' Trails for the enhanced portable variant

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 for the PS2 primary route and PPSSPP for Blazin' Trails.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS2 presentation with internal-resolution upscaling plus PSP variant preservation

primary.why: ATV Offroad Fury 3 released on PlayStation 2, with an enhanced PSP version titled ATV Offroad Fury: Blazin' Trails. The PS2 release is the higher-fidelity home version, while the PSP version should be preserved separately as an enhanced portable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS2 version on original hardware or PCSX2, then use PPSSPP for Blazin' Trails if preserving the PSP variant.

secondary.why: The PSP version is described as an enhanced version and supports Wi-Fi multiplayer, making it worth preserving after the PS2 route.
secondary.how_to_play: Play with PPSSPP or original PSP hardware.

all_releases.fidelity: Original higher-fidelity home-console release with online multiplayer and customization.
Enhanced portable version released as ATV Offroad Fury: Blazin' Trails, with Wi-Fi multiplayer.
all_releases.reason: secondary: preserves the enhanced PSP variant.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PS2 is the higher-fidelity home route, while the PSP Blazin' Trails version is an enhanced portable variant worth preserving separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or modern rerelease.

entries.title: ATV Offroad Fury 4
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation 2 release plus PSP ATV Offroad Fury Pro for exclusive content

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 for the PS2 primary route and PPSSPP for ATV Offroad Fury Pro.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS2 presentation with internal-resolution upscaling plus PSP exclusive-content preservation

primary.why: ATV Offroad Fury 4 released on PlayStation 2, with the PSP version ATV Offroad Fury Pro released around the same time. The PS2 version has the higher-fidelity home-console campaign and supports unlocking classic tracks via PSP save synchronization, while Pro has different tracks, exclusive vehicles, mini-games, soundtrack, and snowmobile/rally car classes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS2 version on PCSX2 or original hardware, then play ATV Offroad Fury Pro on PPSSPP for its PSP-exclusive content.

secondary.why: The PSP version has different tracks, exclusive vehicles, mini-games, soundtrack, and snowmobile/rally car classes, so it is required for complete series preservation.
secondary.how_to_play: Play with PPSSPP or original PSP hardware; use save synchronization with PS2 hardware if preserving the classic-track unlock flow.

all_releases.fidelity: Original higher-fidelity home-console release with new vehicle types, story mode, mini-games, online play, and classic-track unlock support via PSP sync.
ATV Offroad Fury Pro portable version with different tracks, exclusive vehicles, mini-games, soundtrack, snowmobiles, and rally cars.
all_releases.reason: secondary: preserves PSP-exclusive content and vehicle classes.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PS2 is the higher-fidelity main route, but the PSP Pro version has exclusive content and vehicle classes, so both are needed for full preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or modern rerelease.
